title: Space Class Specification: Permitted Vehicles, Length Limits and Facilities of the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
Each space class under the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement is specified by the vehicles it takes and the facilities that come with it. The maximum vehicle length is the longest vehicle, including trailer tongue and outboard motor, that may use the space, in feet.

### 1. Permitted vehicle types and maximum length

| Space class | Maximum vehicle length | Permitted vehicle types |
|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space | 20 ft | car or pickup; motorcycle; utility trailer |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | 30 ft | car or pickup; boat on trailer; travel trailer; Class B motorhome; Class C motorhome; utility trailer |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | 45 ft | boat on trailer; travel trailer; fifth-wheel trailer; Class A motorhome; Class C motorhome |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | 30 ft | car or pickup; boat on trailer; travel trailer; Class B motorhome; Class C motorhome; utility trailer |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | 45 ft | boat on trailer; travel trailer; fifth-wheel trailer; Class A motorhome; Class C motorhome |
| Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage | 40 ft | car or pickup; motorcycle; boat on trailer; travel trailer; fifth-wheel trailer; Class A motorhome; Class B motorhome; Class C motorhome |

### 2. Facilities included with the space

| Space class | Roof canopy (covered) | Fully enclosed garage with own door | 30-amp battery-maintenance outlet | RV dump station | Wash bay | Gate access hours |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space | No | No | No | No | No | 06:00 to 22:00 |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | 06:00 to 22:00 |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | 06:00 to 22:00 |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | Yes | No | No | Yes | Yes | 06:00 to 22:00 |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | 06:00 to 22:00 |
| Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 24 hours |

### 3. Reading the specification

- A motorcycle is a permitted type only in the Bluegate Uncovered Car Space and the Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage.
- A fifth-wheel trailer and a Class A motorhome are permitted only in the two 31-45 ft classes and the Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage.
- The battery-maintenance outlet is included only with the Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) and the Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage; the Bluegate Uncovered Car Space is the one class without dump station and wash bay use.
- Example (hypothetical): a 32 ft travel trailer exceeds the 30 ft limit of both up-to-30 ft classes; by length and type it is within the 31-45 ft classes and the 40 ft limit of the Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage.
